notes: Comprehensive 60 FPS GUI performance overhaul: persistent double-buffering, zero-allocation paint loops, pre-rendered waveform caching, and 0.0% CPU idle throttling.

ChromaCore.notes: Pristine pure analog sine calculation, Mod Osc Dry/Wet and target decoupling, Filter 1/2 and Master Global Cutoff mod matrix disentanglement.

ChromaPulse.notes: Pre-rendered waveform caching replacing 1,416 vector DrawLines with a single BitBlt.

ChromaDeep.notes: Zero-allocation persistent backbuffer and idle repaint throttling across all 7 tabs.

ChromaX.notes: Flagship wavetable super-synth with 3D keycaps and zero-alloc double buffering.

ChromaComp.notes: Sidechain telemetry gating and idle repainting throttling.

ChromaVerb.notes: Wireframe room acoustic visualizer decay gating and persistent backbuffer.

ChromaDelay.notes: Tape/BBD visualizer decay gating and zero-alloc paint loop.

ChromaFhaser.notes: 3D waterfall decay gating and persistent double-buffering.

ChromaSlice.notes: RMS detector gating and persistent double-buffering.

ChromaTransientShaper.notes: Peak telemetry gating and zero-alloc backbuffer.

ChromaVoice.notes: Eliminated 5.2 kHz vocal zap, smoothed unvoiced delay, unified dual pitch-grain heads, added universal update chiclet.

ChromaWidener.notes: Multiband spatializer with decay-gated idle throttling.
